meta.name: Student of the Year: After Dark
meta.description: Student of the Year: After Dark reimagines the St. Teresa's campus as the setting of a murder mystery after the school's queen bee, Aayesha Malik, is found dead in a frozen lake. Refusing to believe it was an accident, her introverted twin sister Aditi goes undercover at the elite institution to investigate her death.

videos.title: Secrets
videos.overview: Former child star Aayesha is found drowned in a lake. Suspecting foul play, her estranged twin Aditi enrols in her school and suspects Aayesha's friends are hiding a secret.

videos.title: Trust Issues
videos.overview: Tracker tokens, a history of bullying, possible evidence tampering, mysterious CCTV footage and a kidnapping! Aditi stumbles across much more before Round 1 of the competition.

videos.title: Ambition
videos.overview: Aditi uncovers the motives of Aayesha's classmates to enter the competition, which can make the winner's biggest dreams come true. How will Aditi leverage this information?

videos.title: False Memories
videos.overview: Aditi kidnaps her prime suspects to interrogate them about the party on the night of Aayesha's death. As Aditi pieces together the clues, she recalls a painful childhood memory.

videos.title: Heartbreak
videos.overview: Aditi finds more clues that caused Aayesha to drown in the icy lake. In the competition's next round, a psychological challenge uncovers a disturbing image in Aayesha's phone.

videos.title: Nightmare
videos.overview: The case seems solved, and Aditi prepares to leave. But Rehaan's revelation about the previous dean's death and the final round lead Aditi to finally solve her sister's death.
